items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: So my brother-in-law, Shorty Allen, the piano player, he’s married to my sister

ctx.x: Well as time passed, eventually you got to work with your uncle?

Yes, my Uncle Phil. And that’s a funny story too, because he had really a great Dixieland band, and I couldn’t play Dixieland one, not one note. So my brother-in-law, Shorty Allen, the piano player, he’s married to my sister, and the four of us and somebody else, I forget who was with us, we went to New York to see “Some Like it Hot.” And when we came out we said let’s go see Uncle Phil at Nick’s. He was working at Nick’s. So we go to see him at Nick’s. Now Phil, he knew that Shorty and I were like considered…
The Memphis Five was it called?
